title: Solutions Attorney
location: San Mateo, California; Remote - United States; Remote - Canada
posting_excerpt:
ate your preferred track when applying:

 - Go to Market: This team partners directly with the sales organization to drive revenue by demonstrating GC AI’s value in complex, high-stakes environments. You will serve as a subject matter expert on pitches across all client segments, tailoring and providing product demonstrations to specific legal workflows and prospect needs.

 - Forward Deployed: This team focuses on the long-term lifecycle of the customer, driving retention, high-touch product adoption, and consultative workflow design. You will own implementation and ongoing technical/strategic customer support, handling consultative problem solving like custom prompt engineering, playbook creation, and workflow optimization.

 - Academy: This team owns the educational engine of GC AI, creating industry-leading Legal AI content and managing the logistics of our instructional offerings. You will act as a dedicated owner of all Academy course content, building new classes and refining existing materials to ensure content scales alongside product releases.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Draft high-impact AI prompts that solve real-world legal problems and demonstrate value across industries and practice areas.

 - Curate a library of sample prompts and outputs to showcase the versatility of GC AI to both prospects and customers.

 - Partner with in-house lawyers to deeply understand their workflows (research, contracts, diligence, document analysis, compliance, etc.) and design practical AI-powered solutions.

 - Act as the Voice of the Customer by sharing insights with Product, ensuring features evolve to meet real-world legal needs.

 - Lead prompting workshops and training sessions to boost customer adoption and confidence in using AI effectively.

 - Position GC AI as the trusted legal AI partner by bringing credibility, expertise, and empathy to every interaction.

 


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of experience practicing law, including at least 2 years practicing (or working in legal ops) in-house.

 - A genuine passion for AI and you already use it and love experimenting with it.

 - Proven ability to learn quickly, think critically, and apply knowledge creatively.

 - Hands-on experience with legal tech tools (e.g. CLM, automation, or other legal software).

 - Excellent client-facing skills: empathetic, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing or teaching training programs, workshops, or courses.

 - Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM-powered tools, or workflow automation.

 - Background in legal innovation, knowledge management, or legal tech adoption.

 - Strong community-building instincts, and you enjoy connecting people and sharing knowledge.




A NOTE ON PACE

We’re building something new in a once-in-a-generation shift in technology and the legal industry, so we move at a relentless pace. We expect urgency, ownership, and good judgment even when things aren’t perfectly clear. If you need structure and consensus to do your best work, this isn’t the right place for you. If you thrive in ambiguity and growth, work with intensity, and want real responsibility, keep reading. We’re excited to meet you.




HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

GC AI is a distributed company with team members across North America, and soon Europe. We believe that because our business is AI, human connection matters more, not less. We invest in bringing people together through our hub model: regular coworking sessions, customer dinners, team and company offsites. If you’re in a location without an office, expect up to 10% travel (and more for customer-facing roles).

Team members in the San Francisco Bay Area and Provo, UT (within 50 miles of the office) work together on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. As we grow, we plan to establish permanent offices in more hub cities https://gc-ai.notion.site/fa

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Alpaca is growing its Treasury function as we scale our product suite, global footprint, and self-clearing operations. We are looking for a Financial Risk Manager to support the development and day-to-day execution of Alpaca's liquidity risk monitoring and stress testing program.

This is a hands-on, analytical role for someone who wants broad exposure across Treasury, Finance, Operations, and Risk. You will work closely with the Head of Treasury and partner cross functionally to help maintain sound liquidity governance and produce rigorous analysis under both business-as-usual and stressed conditions. This role is responsible for building out Alpaca's liquidity risk infrastructure from the ground up. You will establish daily liquidity reporting, streamline data pipelines, implement intraday monitoring and stress testing capabilities, develop longer-term and Monte Carlo-based stress testing frameworks, and build the alerting and controls needed to support Treasury decision-making as Alpaca launches new products and expands into new markets.

While the title reflects managerial scope over liquidity risk and stress testing workstreams, this is primarily an individual contributor role with opportunity to grow into broader leadership as the function matures.

What You'll Do:

Key Priorities

- This role will be responsible for building out the following core capabilities:

- Daily liquidity reporting and streamlined data pipelines

- Intraday liquidity monitoring

- Intraday stress testing

- Longer-term stress testing

- Monte Carlo simulations for stress testing

- Alerting frameworks and other necessary controls

- Daily Liquidity Reporting & Data Pipelines

- Build and own daily liquidity reporting, ensuring timely, accurate views of firm liquidity positions across products and legal entities

- Design and streamline data pipelines connecting Treasury, Finance, Operations, and clearing/settlement systems to reduce manual effort and improve data quality

- Help maintain broker-dealer liquidity reporting related to SEC Rule 15c3-1 (Net Capital), SEC Rule 15c3-3 (Customer Reserve), and related FINRA/SEC requirements

- Partner with Engineering and Data teams to automate reporting workflows using SQL, Python, and BI platforms

Intraday Monitoring

- Build and maintain real-time and intraday liquidity monitoring capabilities to track cash positions, settlement flows, margin movements, and funding needs throughout the day

- Establish intraday liquidity metrics, limits, and early warning indicators (EWIs); investigate breaches and prepare escalation materials for Treasury leadership

title: R&D Attorney
posting_excerpt:
- 🤝 Care: be direct, like an honest friend, even when it’s uncomfortable.

 - 🎯 Own It: full accountability, proactive communication, and attention to detail.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As an R&D Attorney, you will shape the products, features, and AI experiences that legal teams rely on every day. You will combine legal expertise, product judgment, and a practical understanding of how legal teams work to define what excellent legal AI looks like. Working alongside engineers as a legal expert, product partner, and advanced user, you will design legal evaluations, translate real-world workflows into product requirements, test and refine new features, and turn customer feedback into lasting improvements. You will help decide what we build, set the standard for launch readiness, and shape the future of legal AI for in-house teams.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and run rigorous evaluations that define and measure whether our AI-generated work meets the high standards expected by top-tier legal professionals.

 - Review and validate product outputs for accuracy, relevance, comprehensiveness, helpfulness, etc.

 - Turn customer feedback into lasting improvements by identifying root causes, determining whether the solution requires a prompt, skill, tool, or broader product change, and creating tests that prevent recurrence.

 - Work alongside engineering, product, design, and GTM teams to shape products and features from initial discovery through requirements, prioritization, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

 - Serve as the legal voice of quality, advocating for precision, consistency, and clarity in AI outputs.

 - Operate as a product manager, legal expert, and advanced user by translating real legal workflows and customer needs into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and roadmap recommendations.

 - Provide domain-specific legal expertise that guides feature development and product roadmap decisions.

 - Help build products that lawyers trust and want to use, combining legal judgment, product thinking, customer insight, and hands-on experimentation.

 


WHAT YOU'VE DONE

 - Law degree and license to practice law .

 - 5+ years of legal experience, ideally with meaningful in-house experience.

 - Substantive depth in one or more areas of in-house legal work, such as corporate-commercial or transactional law, contract drafting and negotiation, product or regulatory counseling, privacy, compliance, employment, fintech or litigation work.

 - Experience using generative AI for legal work and evaluating generative AI outputs.

 - Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design metrics, interpret evaluation results, and turn legal reasoning into logical, repeatable steps.

 - Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work closely with Engineering, Product, and GTM teams.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - You are already a GC AI user.

 - You care about user experience, especially how legal professionals interact with and trust AI assistants.

 - You have worked closely with software engineers before.

 - Ability to design and interpret evaluation metrics and to abstract legal reasoning and processes into logical, repeatable steps.

posting_excerpt:

Spacecraft licensing is the core of this role. You will lead the legal aspects of the company's spacecraft and ground station licensing efforts across all missions, working closely with systems engineering, mission operations, and communications teams to translate technical requirements into complete, timely, and defensible regulatory filings. You will manage license portfolios, track compliance obligations, and serve as the go-to resource for stakeholders across the company on licensing requirements and timelines.

Beyond licensing, you will also support general corporate legal functions — reviewing and negotiating contracts, advising internal clients, and contributing to the legal department's broader workload. The ideal candidate is energized by the opportunity to own a specialized regulatory function while also operating as a versatile member of a lean legal team.

Responsibilities

Spacecraft and Ground Station Licensing

- Manage the full lifecycle of spacecraft licensing for all True Anomaly missions, including NTIA, FCC, NOAA, and other applicable license applications, modifications, renewals, and amendments.

- Serve as the company's internal subject matter expert on FCC experimental, STA and Part 25 licenses; NOAA commercial remote sensing regulations; and other regulatory frameworks governing spacecraft and ground station operations.

- Support ground station coordination and RF platform development from a regulatory and licensing perspective.

- Prepare, coordinate, and submit license applications on tight timelines, working with systems engineering, mission operations, and communications teams to gather and validate technical inputs.

- Support NTIA and ITU coordination and applications as required.

- Prepare and manage Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs) to ensure compliance with license conditions and regulatory requirements.

- Ensure alignment across the organization on regulatory and RF compliance requirements, identifying and driving closure on gaps.

- Monitor and track post-license compliance obligations, including reporting requirements, operational conditions, and modification triggers.

- Maintain a licensing tracker and compliance calendar to provide visibility into application status, deadlines, and upcoming obligations.

- Monitor FCC, NOAA, and other relevant agency rulemaking, proposed rules, and policy developments that may affect the company's current or planned licensing posture, and proactively advise stakeholders on potential impacts.

- Develop and maintain relationships with relevant regulatory agency staff to support effective engagement on current and future applications.

General Corporate Legal Support

- Draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of agreements, including vendor and supplier contracts, program subcontracts, teaming agreements, NDAs, and consulting agreements.

- Advise internal stakeholders across program management, systems engineering, communications and IT, mission operations, facilities management, security, finance, and supply chain on legal matters as they arise.

- Coordinate with other Legal Department functions, including export compliance, on matters of overlapping regulatory concern.

- Contribute to legal department process improvements, templates, playbooks, and other shared resources.

- Support additional projects and initiatives as needed under the direction of the Senior Associate General Counsel.

Required Qualifications

- J.D. from an accredited law school.

- Active bar membership in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

- 3–7 years of legal experience, with a preference for a mix of law firm and in-house experience.

- Direct experience preparing, reviewing, and submitting spacecraft and/or ground station FCC and NOAA license applications to tight timelines.

- Experience supporting NTIA application
